notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
easyPrerequisites:
Pheres-Band Tromper doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Kelpie Guide is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper using Kelpie Guide's ability by tapping it, untapping another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the other creature using Kelpie Guide's ability by tapping it, untapping Pheres-Band Tromper
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
